brief: Replace strings matching a regular expression
description: Replaces matches of the regular expression in <dataType> value, left to right, up to limit times. An empty match is replaced too.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

parameters.description: The replacement for each match. $n is the text of group n ($0 the whole match), ${name} the text of a named group, and a backslash makes the next character literal (\$ for a dollar sign). Any other $ is an error.
parameters.name: replacement

parameters.description: The maximum number of matches to replace. The default is 1. Specify -1 (or any negative) to replace every match.
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Result text as string (not re-typed as the input data type).
